rationale.description: Short explanation of how the task title was inferred from the original Slack message.

reminder_message.description: One-line imperative reminder title: a verb plus a concrete object, about 4 to 14 words and at most 90 characters, summarizing requested work rather than repeating a long list or background. No @-mentions, no URLs, no 'please', never a question, never cut off with '…'.
